scope: Bounded prior-sensitivity importance analysis of all three completed small synthetic datasets; not SBC
baseline_prior: Independent bounded uniforms for physical scalars, standard Gaussian for all 64 white coordinates
prior_choices: Same support in every case. Log-amplitude means density proportional to 1/alpha. Independent zero-mean truncated Gaussians for b_delta2, b_K2, b_laplacian use scales half the baseline half-widths. b_delta and white priors unchanged. Choices precede evaluation and are not fitted to generating truths.
policy: Report every dataset/case, including overlap/precision failures. Never pool datasets or discard chains, choose priors by truth recovery, replace a failed case, or extend chains until pass. Sensitivity size has no pass/fail threshold. Failed reliability screens require new separately declared sampling; no automatic rerun.
limits: Reweighted existing chains, not newly validated alternative-prior MCMC
Importance overlap is not autocorrelation-corrected MCMC ESS
Paired batch/chain MCSE estimates mean-shift uncertainty only; weighted intervals have no certified tail precision
An overlap/precision screen cannot rule out unsampled alternative-prior modes
All supports remain fixed; this does not test broader priors
Three fixed-truth realizations are not prior-predictive SBC or a coverage estimate
Small synthetic same-model target, no real catalog or production MPI replica orchestration
